title: sUSDe operates as Ethena's reward-accruing USDe vault receipt
description: Ethena documents sUSDe as a transferable token-vault receipt created by staking USDe, with rewards reflected in an increasing USDe conversion value per share.
notes: Current model event; no unsupported day-level launch date is asserted.

title: sDAI retained with limited legacy status after the Sky transition
description: Current Sky documentation still distinguishes sDAI from sUSDS and the official contract lineage remains available, but Sky's current savings product and public documentation prioritize sUSDS.
notes: This is a registry status review, not a termination claim.

title: sUSDS becomes the active Sky Savings Rate vault share
description: Sky documents sUSDS as the current ERC-4626 savings wrapper for USDS, supporting USDS deposits and withdrawals without protocol fees on the vault route.
notes: Current model event; exact initial launch date remains outside this batch.

title: USDY is folded into the Ondo Global Markets umbrella
description: Ondo states that USDY, formerly issued by Ondo USDY LLC, was folded into the Ondo Global Markets umbrella on 15 December 2025.
notes: The product remains active; the event records its current issuer-side structure.

title: Circle acquires Hashnote and the USYC tokenized fund business
description: Circle announced the acquisition of Hashnote and USYC, followed by integration of USYC under Circle International Bermuda's regulated token administration.
notes: USYC remains the tokenized representation of the underlying Cayman mutual fund after the acquisition.
